### [CORE_SUMMARY]
Born a Dalakitnon to a destitute family in the Philippines, his rare genetic and spiritual architecture and extreme charisma made him a corporate asset for Mitsuhama. Reconstructed into a pan-Asian idol group, TXM (The Death Messengers), he was used as a gateway for massive collective geomantic rituals. Sabotaging a mega-ritual to save the woman he loved, he vanished into the shadows, now running dirty jobs to build a network to protect her from afar.
:::
